meta.title: Changelog — what shipped in MepMail
meta.description: Every recent MepMail release, newest first: value-first landing and official logos, /security and /support, notification channels, open beta, plan limits and the migration CLI — with the date each one reached main.

hero.title: What <highlight>shipped</highlight>, release by release.
hero.lead: MepMail is built in the open. This is the running list of releases, newest first — what changed, dated by the day it reached the product. The same history lives in the repository's CHANGELOG.md.
hero.note: The beta is open and self-serve: create a free account, no card required.

feed.title: Recent releases
feed.body: Six of the most recent releases. Earlier history is in the repository changelog.

releases.title: Value-first landing, official logos and +10% quotas
releases.summary: The public site starts from the value proposition and real brand logos, and every sending quota grew by 10%.

items: The landing now leads with the value proposition and a mural of official integration logos instead of a feature wall.
Official, full-colour brand marks across the home, /integrations and the product mockup.
A flat, responsive header with a balanced footer — Product, Compare, Account and Legal columns on every public page.
Sending quotas raised by 10% end to end (core, panel, docs and tests).
A back-to-site link on the authentication screens, so sign-in and sign-up no longer strand the visitor.

releases.title: Institutional pages and plan limits v2
releases.summary: /security and /support ship as showcase pages, /integrations opens, and the plans carry more domains and workspaces.

items: /security and /support as showcase pages: controls, subprocessors, the compliance roadmap (SOC 2 / ISO 27001 as roadmap items, never headlines) and the enterprise FAQ.
/integrations, with the vendor mural and per-tool setup cards.
security.txt.
Plan limits v2: more domains and workspaces, unlimited contacts on Starter.
Localised landing prices (US separators in English, per-locale volume labels).

releases.title: Notification channels, templates and Microsoft sign-in
releases.summary: Slack, Discord and Telegram channels, a gallery of ready-made templates and social sign-in with Microsoft.

items: Slack, Discord and Telegram notification channels, formatted automatically from the webhook URL.
A gallery of ready-made templates (10 starters, EN/PT) with preview and one-click copy.
Social sign-in with Microsoft (better-auth), in both locales.

releases.title: Console, operator tooling and agent discovery
releases.summary: An operator Console, the MCP server card at the MCP origin, channel attribution on sign-up and the first documentation wave.

items: An operator Console: instance users, audit, regions and safety, plus a Users tile in the overview.
The MCP server card now also served at the MCP endpoint origin, with its tools[] published.
Channel attribution on sign-up and server-side funnel events in Umami.
A Telegram alert on new sign-ups, carrying the utm/campaign origin.
Documentation wave 1: the npm packages page, rate limits with Retry-After, the error catalogue and the MCP install path.

releases.title: Open beta, SEO and self-serve docs
releases.summary: Open sign-up on the landing and in the docs, robots.txt and sitemap.xml unblocked, self-hosted analytics and the CLI's doctor command.

items: Open sign-up on the landing and in the docs: no invite, no seat limit; each account is capped at 100 emails a day on the Free plan.
Self-hosted analytics (Umami) wired into the web app.
doctor and emails list/get in the migration CLI.
robots.txt and sitemap.xml unblocked, with the legal pages indexed.
Vitest testTimeout pinned in apps/web; a CLI 404 no longer blames the URL and --after is validated as a UUID.
Mobile landing header kept on-screen, with the sign-up CTA always visible.

releases.title: Legal pages and a conversion-focused landing
releases.summary: Terms, Privacy and Refunds pages plus a landing round built around the demo, trust and the founders program.

items: Terms, Privacy and Refunds pages (PT/EN) with a fixed Legal column in the footer.
Landing conversion round: demo, trust, founders program, FAQ, CTAs and the MCP section.

close.title: See the next release as it lands.
close.body: Create a free account and follow the product from the inside — the beta is open, no card required.
